nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The first short conserved-motif occurrence is a reliable coordinate anchor for the full amplicon.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The windowed method returned no high-coverage hit for any dominant query, including the sequence independently matched to Escherichia coli at 100% identity over all 253 bases.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The first occurrence of the short motif need not flank the sequenced interval, so cropping can remove the true alignment.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Search intact references and require an exact positive-control match before interpreting coverage failures.

submitted_final_answer: The number of tissue groups, the number of host species, and the names of the hosts and tissues cannot be determined from the 18 FASTA files alone. A sample-to-host-and-tissue mapping is needed.
